rule: Frozen rule:  * Pool: Chai-1 test-split systems with the complete 5 x 5 design whose public RNP input has exactly one protein sequence and one SMILES (the E22 rule), with at most 768 Chai tokens after padding (residues plus ligand heavy atoms). * Confidence: mean over the five archived seeds of the seed-level top ranking score. * Tiers: tertiles of that confidence within the pool (low, mid, high). * Allocation: 40 low, 30 mid and 20 high systems. Within a tier, systems are ordered by sha256("cofoldpilot-seedext-v1:" + system_id); the first system of each RNP cluster is kept and the first n systems are taken. * Seeds: the five archived RNP seeds (ascending) followed by 15 new seeds, int(sha256(f"cofoldpilot-seedext-v1-seed:{system_id}:{j}").hexdigest()[:8], 16) % 2**31 for j = 1, 2, ..., skipping values already used for the system. * Array tasks: 12, assigned longest first by the E22 per-seed time of the padded size.
